name: PhotoPrism
description: Photo library with face recognition, maps and albums. Reads the 'photo' shared folder.
notes: Sign in as admin with password ${SECRET}
compose:
services:
  photoprism:
    image: photoprism/photoprism:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "2342:2342"
    environment:
      - PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SECRET}
      - PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL=http://${HOST}:2342/
      - PHOTOPRISM_DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite
    volumes:
      - ${SHARE:photo}:/photoprism/originals
      - ./storage:/photoprism/storage
